title: MOS
description: Generated scales with two step sizes and balanced structure.

title.label: Title
title.heading: MOS
title.body: A moment of symmetry, or MOS, is a generated scale where the notes divide the period into only two step sizes. MOS scales are important because they balance regular construction with musically useful variety.

lab.label: Lab
lab.prompt: The MOS lab will go here.

qa.label: Q&A
qa.question: What is a hallmark of a MOS scale?

choices.text: It has only two step sizes around the period.
It must always have twelve notes.

items.title: Spot two step sizes
items.body: Imagine a scale with large and small steps and describe how it might still feel balanced.

items.title: Connect to a generator
items.body: Explain how stacking one interval can produce a scale with only two step sizes.
